articles.title: Apps and Social Media - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Your phone is an essential tool in Grand Theft Auto VI, packed with apps that can get you from A to B, protect your cash, and help you keep in touch with
articles.body:
Your phone is an essential tool in Grand Theft Auto VI, packed with apps that can get you from A to B, protect your cash, and help you keep in touch with important contacts. Apps will naturally unlock as you progress through Lucia and Jason's story, but if you've not yet explored all your newly loaded features, this official IGN GTA 6 guide will help you get familiar with them all.

Your phone will come loaded with several standard apps, which include your Contacts, Camera, Gallery, News, and Weather.

Contacts: If you find a new number, or someone new gets in touch, you'll be able to reach out to them via Contacts.

Camera: Want to take a selfie, or capture something cool you find around Leonida? Open up your camera.

Gallery: If you've already taken a few shots, you can then view them in your Gallery.

News: Stay up to date with all the weird and wonderful things going in Leonida through the red news app. This allows you to scroll through a feed of stories from The Leonida Journal, Weazel News, Vice City Horn, and more.

Weather: Finally, you can get a 2-day forecast by opening up the weather app, and even see when the sun sets.

You'll often see notifications at the top of your phone. This is worth opening up each day, as it gives you hints on outstanding messages, news articles, recent Snapmatic posts, and missed calls that are worth checking out.

Whenever you get a new message, this is where it goes. All unread messages will have a red dot next to them. Contacts can also attach photos, and coordinates, meaning when you open a message, your map will automatically update with new locations.

Traveling around Leonida sometimes means your vehicle is elsewhere. But if you want help with that, Scooter Bros is the app to use. You can set a destination for you car to be sent to. You'll pay a flat fee for the request, then an additional fee for the distance that Scooter Bros need to cover to get the vehicle back to you.

Don't feel like driving? You don't have to, though it can be costly to use the RydeMe app depending on where you're going. You can choose a Ryde, or Book Ryde, and then select Change Destination. This will open up the map, so you just need to place a pin down on where you wanna go.

Who needs a bank account when you can use BuckMe? This app is a quick way to keep track of your finances. You'll have an individual checking account, as well as a savings accounts, where you can keep track of your next goals. Rather than stash your cash away under some floorboards, you'll be able to deposit it quickly into your BuckMe account. All cash will have to be deposited via an ATM, but BuckMe makes it easy to do that. Just use the ATM finder, and the closest ATM will be marked for you.

What you eat, how often you exercise, and your general health will all have an impact on Jason and Lucia's journey. The Fitness app will not only let you track whether or not you're hungry, but also tells you when your workout window is, so you can stay consistent and avoid losing your gains. Additionally, you'll be able to track your Focus Level, which you can improve with a variety of activities including Meditation, Fishing, and Basketball.

All kinds of things are happening in Leonida, and you can keep up with them all via Snapmatic. Explore posts from people you know, or just watch viral videos to pass the time. You can view the comments, and if there's any posts you particularly enjoy, you can like them to view again later.

WAiNK is an app designed for scanning landmarks , locations, sculptures , and vehicles. This app is essential for completing collections and making 100% progress. When there's something nearby that you can scan, you'll get a notification that pops up to tell you that you can WAiNK it.

When you car collection begins to expand, you'll want to dive into the Vice City Real Estate app to see what properties are available. This allows you to purchase garages, so you can unlock more parking spots, and keep your favorite vehicles safe.

Lastly, there's the Settings app. You can make cosmetic adjustments here, including changing your wallpaper and ringtone. But you'll also unlock third party plugins as you progress through the story, including the Cop Scanner and Key Cloner.

articles.title: You Have to Become a Complete Psychopath to Get A 6 Star Wanted Level in GTA 6
articles.summary: GTA 6 sees the return of the classic six-star wanted system, but gaining the highest level demands much more outrageous criminal behaviour than you might expect.
articles.body:
Warning: things are about to get very silly, and you may even question if I have a soul left to save.

Following a brief dip down to five stages in GTA 5, the full six-star wanted level system is back in GTA 6 . As you begin your new criminal adventure, you might be wondering exactly what you need to do to trigger the largest police response to your fiendish Vice City activities. How do you hit the full six stars ?

The short answer is: become a psychopath. The longer answer is a little more complicated, requires quite a bit of effort to get there and, arguably, involves relinquishing each of your morals one by one. Here’s how I got a six-star wanted level in GTA 6.

The classic six wanted stars sit in the top right-hand corner of the HUD throughout your journey across the state of Leonida, but the truth is, over the course of the story, you’ll never quite max them out. Five stars are often triggered during some of the main missions' higher-stakes moments, but that final step remains elusive if you purely follow the story. You really have to go out of your way to draw enough attention from the cops, high-powered NOOSE teams, and whatever land, sea, and air vehicles may be headed your way to hit six stars. Really, the only way to do it is to commit some pretty abhorrent atrocities, mainly involving the murder of dozens of civilians or cops. Furthermore, due to the realistic nature of GTA 6’s world and the lifelike way its population reacts to your every action, it can genuinely be quite a harrowing endeavour, especially when compared to the more cartoonish nature of the series’ previous entries.

Despite all that, I really couldn’t play GTA 6 without seeing what happens at six stars at least once. And so I had to push on, grinding the corpses of innocents beneath my feet and tires, all in the name of curiosity. And journalism (seriously, this is one of the more unusual requests I’ve had from an editor.) Please know that I know how absurd everything I’m about to describe sounds.

As any longtime GTA player will know, a quick and easy way to draw police attention is to break into the airport. Vice City International Airport is located west of Downtown, and there’s a series of barriers to the southeast of the airfield that gets you pretty close to a bunch of private and cargo jets. Putting pedal to the metal, I rammed through the barriers and hijacked the biggest airborne beast I could – I was looking to create as much mayhem as possible, afterall. By the time I hit the runway I had secured four stars – all without killing anyone. Of course, cargo jets are massive and I was planning to make a massive impact, so that non-lethal streak was about to end shortly. Again, all of this really does require you to remember that this is all a video game and these people aren’t real.

Once airborne, I steered the jet southeast to line up its nose with the length of Ocean Beach. Yes, the beach full of happy, joyful, relaxing people. If the high-octane set pieces of the campaign could never trigger five stars, then there really was no other option than the most heinous act I could think of. Unsurprisingly, fighter jets pulled up alongside me, intercepting my mission. I collided with one, bringing this initial attempt to an early finish. If you’re planning on trying this, try to avoid smashing into them.

Another thing to avoid: tearing your landing gear apart by ploughing into the boarding stairs when taking off. That was my second try foiled before I’d even left the runway. Look, I never said I was a professional when it comes to mayhem. But once I’d managed to get in the air with all wheels in tact and avoid the intercepting jets, I was well positioned to land the cargo plane on the sand, piling into as many vacation-goers as possible in one fell swoop.

Despite this act being horrifically, soul-twistingly violent, across my numerous attempts I discovered it wasn’t actually guaranteed to trigger the five star wanted level. Somehow, this was considered by the authorities to be no worse than an airline hijack. If you find yourself in the same position, feel free to lob some sticky bombs at the arriving cops or flick into focus mode to land some clean headshots. That should get you up to five.

At this point, I’d attracted quite the police presence, which meant the beach was swarming with armoured trucks and all-terrain vehicles – the perfect tools to drive up and down the beach, ramming into as many people as possible. Once again, I’m very aware that I’m basically committing a heinous terrorist attack here, but I have been tasked with writing this and am really trying to make it clear that my moral character should not be judged by my actions in a video game, especially not by those in a court of law, thank you very much. Let me know if I’m succeeding.

There’s no doubt a little bit of luck involved with this process, as I failed a couple more times before finally reaching my goal of six stars. Sometimes the police actually proved themselves good at aiming, blowing my tires out and sending me spinning slowly to my death. Or you might make my most stupid mistake, stepping out of the safe confines of my vehicle and taking on the whole of the VCPD with a pistol alone.

After a good five or 10 minutes, though, and with a healthy dose of luck, I did it. Eventually, with what felt like the entire city dead at my feet, the sixth star popped.

Rockstar has clearly made it difficult for that final star to arrive. Even once you’ve completed the story and unlocked the cheat code that instantly raises your heat level, that shortcut will only max out at five stars, meaning the final step into psychopath territory always has to be yours to make.

Six stars come with a pretty significant penalty, though, and a warning will appear on screen before you hit the point of no return. If you max out the wanted level, there truly is no escape, and you’ll be hunted down until you’re dead. There’s no way to lower your wanted level once you hit six stars, and fighting your way out – even if you’re loaded up on high-powered weaponry and adrenaline shots – is incredibly difficult. I look forward to seeing people’s record times being set for how long they can maintain six-star pursuits.

If you’re going to try and unleash this amount of violence, I’d thoroughly recommend making a manual save beforehand, as it’s likely to result in permanent repercussions for both Jason and Lucia, as well as your own psyche. Their criminal profiles can fluctuate throughout the game, but committing crimes like this can easily lead to them becoming “irredeemable”, one step above “psychopath”, meaning there’s no going back and sliding them towards the “professional” end of GTA 6’s morality spectrum. Doing so will have consequences that relate to both the storyline and how people react to you within the world. You are, of course, free to take this path, but, in my opinion, much like Red Dead Redemption 2 before it, the overall tone of the couple’s tale is much more befitting of a man and woman trying to be “better people” rather than mass murderers. The choice is yours, though.

Have you managed to reach six stars on the wanted level yet? How long did you manage to evade the police, if so? Do you think I’m unwell for both writing and doing this? Let us know in the comments!

Simon Cardy is a Senior Editor at IGN who can mainly be found skulking around open world games, indulging in Korean cinema, or despairing at the state of Tottenham Hotspur and the New York Jets. Follow him on Bluesky at @cardy.bsky.social .

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Release Day Live Updates, Reaction and Highlights
articles.summary: The 13-year wait is over. Grand Theft Auto 6 is officially here. And the world is reacting accordingly.
articles.body:
On "GTA Day," we were treated to scores of highlights, posts, jokes and memes on the much anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto 6.

And plenty of the reaction came from the sports world.

The Miami Heat themed Wednesday's game with a "Vice City" floor and jerseys. Athletes talked about going straight from work to play the game. You can even shoot some hoops in the open world.

Perhaps most amazing, the number of purchases through release day made this the single biggest release in the history of American media. And it's total haul already exceeds the lifetime box-office number for The Odyssey.

Reaction to all of that and more can be found below in B/R's live blog of the day's events.

articles.title: GTA 6’s First Two Hours Teach You Everything You Need to Know About The Next 100 - IGN
articles.summary: GTA 6’s open world is one packed full of distractions. After its short prologue and quick drug-running operation around the fictional Florida Keys, you wake up as Jason, ready to continue his crime-centred day job as a collections man for his boss, Brian. Three different main mission markers are then offered to you, ushering you into the familiar GTA rhythm you’ll likely spend much of the next 100 hours moving to. But the real beauty of what makes this game so special is the unpredictability of what happens in between those major moments, and the choices you make both in and out of missions. This is how the first two hours teaches you everything you need to know about the next 100 hours in GTA 6.

articles.title: Rockstar Publishes Full GTA 6 Credits — But Beware, They Contain Major Spoilers
articles.summary: With GTA 6 now launched across the world, Rockstar has published the game's full credits online — with a major spoiler hidden in plain view.
articles.body:
With GTA 6 now launched across the world, Rockstar has published the game's full credits online — with some major spoilers hidden in plain view.

Thousands of developers are named on Rockstar's GTA 6 credits page , which also includes a list of the dozens of cast members who portray characters in the game. We reckon around 6,000 names are on the list.

As revealed earlier this week when her Game Awards nomination was announced, Manni L. Perez is the actress behind main character Lucia Caminos . And as confirmed today via our first photo of the game's stars together in real life , Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason Duval is played by actor Dylan Rourke.

Other major characters include Donnie played by True Detective's Brad Carter, Cal played by former Saturday Night Live cast member Bobby Moynihan, Brian Heder played by King of the Hill voice actor Stephen Root, Lori Heder played by prolific voice actress Orlagh Cassidy and Kenton Rees played by Trinidadian singer and songwriter Machel Montano.

Scroll further down the cast list and players will likely spot something that we're going to absolutely label as a spoiler — it's your choice whether you want to read more right now.

Celebrity names in the cast list include a string of celebrity radio hosts, including "Weird Al" Yankovic as DJ Al, Brigitte Nielsen as Madame Brigitte, Puerto Rican rapper and Super Bowl LX halftime show star Bad Bunny as El Martillo, British acting legend Jeremy Irons as DJ Dicky, Gloria and Emilio Estefan as themselves, The Big Bang Theory's Brian Posehn as Big Fan Brian, and the legendary Keith Richards as DJ Keith.

Development-wise, as you'd expect, Rockstar Games founder and executive producer Sam Houser leads the credits list, alongside head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe, plus co-studio heads Rob Nelson and Aaron Garbut. If you're searching for them, the 34 staff fired by Rockstar last year in controversial circumstances are all credited.

There's no sign of Sam Houser's brother and Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser, who left Rockstar in 2020 — despite GTA 6's early development already being underway by this point. GTA 6 is the franchise's first major 3D release not to include his name in the credits. (And no, there's no sign of Leslie Benzies' name either, though he departed several years prior, back in 2016.)

Clearly, GTA 6 was an enormous development effort across Rockstar Games and its parent company, Take-Two, which has yet to announce early sales numbers for the game. We don't know how much GTA 6 cost to make, but we're looking at the most expensive video game ever made, with a budget potentially over the $1 billion mark. Based on preorder estimates, Take-Two will have made its money back on preorders alone.

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

articles.title: GTA 6: The Optional Missions You Won’t Want to Miss
articles.summary: GTA 6 is full of optional activities, but some are more essential than others. These are the seven side missions you really shouldn't miss out on.
articles.body:
Jason and Lucia’s story in GTA 6 is so compelling that you’ll be easily tempted into mainlining their epic tale. But outside of those main missions are some of Leonida’s most weird and wonderful encounters, with multi-stage storylines that you’ll rarely be able to guess where they end up. Trust me, you don’t want to risk skipping the game’s best side activities.

Don’t worry, I won’t be revealing how these quests develop. Instead, I’ll just be showing you where to start them, or in the instances where these missions will come directly to you, why you won’t want to pass on something that looks underwhelming on the surface. Anyway, let’s get on with it. Here are the seven optional missions in GTA 6 you won’t want to miss.

Find yourself peacefully sailing through the Grassrivers, only for that peace to be broken by an ungodly screaming, howling, sort of noise? Well, track down the source, and you’ll find one of the first truly odd things you can witness in GTA 6. Following the stench wafting from a deer carcass into the overgrowth will guide you to a totem that wouldn’t look too out of place in the first series of True Detective. You won’t be looking at it for long, though, before passing out; a pair of legs is the last thing you see.

This could be the end of this particular tale, unless you’re a keen reader of posters, that is. Dotted around the starting area of Key Lento are various flyers asking for information on “Skunk Ape”. Once read, a new contact will be added to your phone. Call Kirk, and he’ll offer to meet up at night, where you can carry on delving into the mystery. Don’t worry, he’s very friendly, and nothing sinister will occur from this point forward.

At the beginning of chapter two, you’ll be pointed in the direction of Kyle McKittrick, a local farmer in the Frogswater area who is in need of a pilot. Turns out, he’s recently broken his arm, so he needs help dusting his crops. That’s where you come in. Take off into the skies and follow his car around, making sure to feed his plants with all of the sweet nutrients they need. On the surface, this may sound like a rather mundane affair, and, to be fair, your first encounter with him will be. But revisit him whenever he’s in need of assistance and the true nature of the questline reveals itself. You’ll never look at a strawberry in the same way again.

Listen to any of the radio station news reports early in the game and you may well hear stories about a “No Flushers” movement — a group proposing a conspiracy theory related to Leonida’s waste management. Actually meeting the people involved won’t come naturally, though. In fact, it wasn’t until hour 80 of my playthrough that I stopped at a notice board in Port Gellhorn to scan a bulletin that led me to them. Once contacted, you’ll be asked to go to a waffle restaurant in Vice City where you’ll meet Dr. Merle. A man with a plan, he’ll flush on this one occasion after eating an intentionally stomach-churning selection from the menu, thus starting the quest for the truth. Follow the tracker he quite literally dumped into the sewage pipes and find where it leads for yourself. It’s bonkers.

There are many different ways to find some of Leonida’s most interesting side missions. Some spin-off from characters you’ll meet in the main story, others are found by the roadside, and some can even be triggered by a quick browse of Snapmatic. That’s how I stumbled upon Dodo Rising, an animal rights group protesting a chimp sanctuary near Vice City International Airport. Talk to them, hand over your info, and you’ll be roped into their fight as you infiltrate their target in an effort to save the apes. And that’s just the first of many missions you’ll be taking on with various quirky members of Dodo Rising, culminating in one of GTA 6’s most bizarre moments.

Not all of these missions are weird, though. Some are much more grounded and can surprise in more traditional ways. That’s the case with Yago, a hopeful street racer you first meet during chapter three. What on the surface looks like a pretty straightforward set of Tokyo Drift-esque races later reveals itself to be much more of a human story with a memorable ending. Even if racing isn’t your favourite GTA 6 side activity, it's very much worth playing through them just to see the hidden depths of Yago’s story, as his inner turmoil battles against the situation he finds himself in.

Who doesn’t love to see a crypto scheme crumble? Well, in GTA 6, maybe it could actually be of benefit to jump on the Bitcoin train if money is foremost on your mind. Such an opportunity presents itself near Ocean Beach in Vice City, with the stuntman extraordinaire, Papa Audacity. This showman/charlatan, depending on your viewpoint, ropes Jason and Lucia into several marketing campaigns for the launch of his Audacity coin. It not only involves several very funny interactions with him and his cronies across the city, but also introduces you to the many different types of stunt challenges that are available to you in its open world. Your first meeting with him may not go quite to plan, but fear not, the type of evil that lurks in the blockchain always finds a way of returning.

And finally, Lucia’s friend Andy plays a big part in chapter one of GTA 6, but she returns much later on as an optional mission giver. Having moved from her Key Lento surroundings, she’s got a new home and job in the plush suburb of Belville, and invites Lucia to visit her. Little does Lucia know that this is to be something more than a friendly house call. Instead, she’s roped into helping out with some deliveries for Cellerica, an unusual new business program.

Deliver your first package to the women around town, and from there you can continue to climb up that Cellerica chain. It’s worth doing to see the story play out, even if it soon seems like a really bad idea to do so. I don’t know about you, but I’d rather set myself on fire than join what I’m sure is a perfectly legitimate business with nothing to hide.

And these are just a handful. There are many, many more mysteries and side quests to find around Leonida. Some are even weirder and wilder than any listed above. Like, for example, if you happen to see an abandoned car near the Starlet Motel with a trail of clothes stretching into the woods, go and check that one out for yourself. If you’re brave enough.

Simon Cardy is a Senior Editor at IGN who can mainly be found skulking around open world games, indulging in Korean cinema, or despairing at the state of Tottenham Hotspur and the New York Jets. Follow him on Bluesky at @cardy.bsky.social .

articles.title: The Nightingale - Official Teaser Trailer - IGN
articles.summary:
Check out the teaser trailer for The Nightingale, an upcoming drama film starring Elle Fanning, Dakota Fanning, Edmund Donovan, Albrecht Schuch, Shira Haas, and Mark Rylance.Based on Kristin Hannah's bestselling novel, The Nightingale stars real-life sisters Elle and Dakota Fanning together onscreen for the first time in the powerful, emotional story of two sisters forced to embark on separate courageous, dangerous paths in a fight for survival and freedom during World War II.

articles.title: Invincible Season 5 Premieres on February 17, 2027
articles.summary: Invincible’s next season flies onto Prime Video on February 17, 2027, and Skybound celebrated with a cheeky trailer teasing what’s next for Mark Grayson and his superpowered compatriots.
articles.body:
Invincible’s next season flies onto Prime Video on February 17, 2027, and Skybound celebrated with a cheeky trailer teasing what’s next for Mark Grayson and his superpowered compatriots.

Fans won’t have to wait much longer to see what comes of the Viltrumites’ big plans, as Season 5 hits streaming on February 17 next year. In fact, it’ll be less than a year between seasons, since Season 4 was released in March 2026.

Prime Video released a humorous advertisement for Season 5 on November 19, showing Mark sitting across from Damien Darkblood at Burger Mart, his regular fast-food haunt that’s packed with a crowd of all-too-familiar faces.

In his chat with Damien, Mark grills the demon detective about whisking him away to hell, seemingly poking fun at fans’ discussions of the side quest.

“You owe me and everyone else for your fun little diversion. It’s more filler than these burgers,” Mark scolds Damien, asking him what he plans on doing to “make up” for his hellish misadventure. Viewers can’t help but notice the likes of Lucan, Anissa, and Kregg in the background.

Damien then explains everything he’s been doing over the last year to help bring Season 5 to life in a montage, where viewers are shown a brief glimpse of a script that opens with a bank robbery. Other than that, we don’t get to see much else — but as Damien points out, the upcoming release date is pretty “exciting.”

Amazon gave us a bit more to chew on in an official press release. The logline for Invincible Season 5 is as follows: “Still reeling from his role in the Earth-shattering events of last season, in Season Five, Mark searches for a way to make the world better, even if that means risking everything — including the relationships, friends, and allies he holds dear. Mark’s forced to decide what kind of hero he is and what he’s willing to do to save his planet’s future — and if the ends always justify the means when millions of lives hang in the balance.”

IGN scored the final episode of Invincible Season 5 a strong 9 out of 10 , with reviewer Siddhant Adlakha calling it the show’s “strongest season yet” that “concludes with a quiet, emotionally affecting entry.”

This is the latest exciting news for the franchise after Season 6 was confirmed in June 2026. Creator Robert Kirkman released a statement remarking on this early renewal, writing, “One of the biggest rewards of building Invincible over the years has been witnessing how new audiences continue to connect with these characters and this world, almost 25 years after its creation.

“This renewal is as much a testament to the passion of our fans as it is to the talented teams bringing the series to life, including longtime supervising directors Shaun O’Neill and Dan Duncan, who have done so much behind the scenes to make Invincible a success, and will now help us continue to grow as executive producers. There’s still so much story left to tell, and I can’t wait for fans to see what’s ahead in seasons 5, 6, and beyond.”

Invincible VS , the 3v3 tag fighting game based on the comic book series-turned-TV show, is also up for Best Fighting Game at the 2026 Game Awards. You can read more about the nominees here, and check out what could be coming next for the game in our exclusive interview with its developers .

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.title: Madden Review: Director David O. Russell Fumbles This Biopic of the Football Icon And Video Game Franchise Namesake
articles.summary: Director David O. Russell fumbles Madden. The movie never makes football particularly interesting, thus failing to connect viewers to the driving force of its subject’s life.
articles.body:
David O. Russell’s erratically directed Madden is an assemblage of montages in search of a story. Is Madden about the relationship between Oakland Raiders coach John Madden and team owner Al Davis? Is it about John’s struggles to be a husband and father when football’s no longer consuming his life? Is it about John proving himself as an announcer? Is it about the creation of EA’s Madden video game franchise ?

Madden the movie casts a wide net around all those topics while never satisfactorily exploring them in any real depth or detail, the whole endeavor playing out like SNL skit after SNL skit without anything ever feeling emotionally genuine. It’s one frantically edited, half-explored sequence set to vintage needledrops after another.

Nicolas Cage is packed into a fat suit and prosthetics as the NFL icon, coming across more like a stage actor starring in Shrek the Musical than a real flesh-and-blood person. Yes, John Madden was an over-the-top figure in real life but the movie and Cage turn him into a cartoon character or the big, bumbling oafish dad in a sitcom. ( Will Ferrell was reportedly up to play Madden before Cage.)

Christian Bale is similarly reduced to makeup and mugging as Al Davis, only occasionally hinting at a real person underneath that greasy, gaudy exterior. Davis’ drive to “just win, baby” certainly fed Madden’s hunger for the game and for victory on the field. Their symbiotic relationship here tries to be the film’s main focus, but the slight story never digs much deeper than the superficial.

John and Al seem made for each other but there's almost a manipulative pusher and junkie dynamic at play. At one point, John tries to break free from Al’s hold over him, but the film is reluctant to show any of its characters in too negative a light.

For both Madden and Davis, it’s their wives – Virginia Madden and Carol Davis, respectively – who help illuminate their larger-than-life spouse’s vulnerabilities, with Kathryn Hahn faring better than Sienna Miller in having an impact. As Virginia, Hahn finds the humor and heart in an otherwise underwritten character (Miller’s Carol is the far more thankless role). Still, Hahn’s is arguably the most emotionally genuine performance in the film.

After a few teases early on, the last half hour of the movie hones in on the creation of the Madden video game . This sequence finally offers the movie a bit more focus and some conflict between John and Al, as the latter doesn’t want John to contribute his time and knowledge to what he deems an inconsequential endeavor when he could come back to work for the Raiders. The SNL skit vibe of the whole film isn’t helped by the casting of John Mulaney as EA’s Trip Hawkins, with the entire EA staff and their endeavor depicted as a bunch of nerds who learn how to be jocks thanks to John Madden’s football know-how.

It’s all pretty condescending. The EA staff are all portrayed as stereotypical geeks, right down to their costuming. In reality, EA’s video game designers of that time were depicted as being akin to rock musicians , not hapless dweebs. Still, there might have at least been a fun Revenge of the Nerds-style film in here had Madden chosen to just chronicle this one chapter of John Madden’s life. Instead, the film is merely a highlight reel, with none of Madden’s accomplishments feeling any more special than the rest.

Between 2022’s Amsterdam and now Madden, director David O. Russell has lost his filmmaking footing after a decade-plus of solid movies (Three Kings, The Fighter , Silver Linings Playbook , American Hustle ). Madden is bewildering in its sloppiness and inability to commit to telling a focused story that does its beloved subject justice.

articles.title: An Estimated 2 Million Eager Xbox Gamers Made Use of the 'New Zealand Trick' to Play GTA 6 Early
articles.summary: Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day early. Dubbed the “New Zealand trick,” the exploit saw players change their region to appear as if they were in another country where the clock struck midnight earliest.
articles.body:
Enough people to fill a third of New Zealand’s population changed their console settings to play GTA 6 a day early. Dubbed the “ New Zealand trick ,” the exploit saw players change their region to appear as if they were in another country where the clock struck midnight earliest.

This happens fairly often for games with a local midnight launch, but GTA 6 saw an unprecedented number of people pretending to be Kiwis. 2 million U.S. and U.K. players took a little trip to New Zealand on November 18 on Xbox alone, according to Ampere Analysis.

1.5m Xbox users in the U.S. took advantage of the loophole, and 600,000 U.K. Xbox users jumped right in with them. The data also only shows some of the story. Playing early is as easy as changing a setting on Xbox, but PlayStation players have to create a whole new account based in the country, and import PSN currency to spend on the store.

These frustrating hoops mean the number was likely significantly lower on PS5, but it probably still wasn’t an insignificant number of people considering GTA 6 game sales are expected to lean heavily towards Sony’s platform. So, the total number of fans using the New Zealand trick will be higher.

New Zealand's official tourism board recently celebrated the launch of GTA 6 by welcoming gamers taking advantage of the trick. "One perk of seeing the sun first? Getting GTA 6 first too," said the post on the New Zealand tourist board's Instagram account.

"We heard a few of you are trying the New Zealand trick to join us. We get it, and we'd love to have you."

While technically against the terms and services of Xbox and PlayStation, the loophole seems to be an accepted grey area for Microsoft and Sony, in so much as neither has said or done anything to clamp down (we've asked for comment). In fact, Xbox has flaunted the trick as a feature for previous game releases. “Kia Ora to all the people who moved to NZ last night!” Microsoft said a Twitter post from Xbox in 2021, celebrating the launch of Forza Horizon 5.

Whether you took the trip or managed to white knuckle it through to the official launch, GTA 6 is finally here and it’s worth the wait. GTA 6 is now the highest rated game of all time . Crikey.

articles.summary: The Radeon RX 9070 XT nearly matches the peformance of the now-$1,500+ GeForce RTX 5070 Ti.
articles.body:
Best Buy is offering a solid deal on a PC that's perfectly suited to run the latest games in 4K. For Black Friday, you can pick up the Acer Nitro 65 Radeon 9070XT prebuilt gaming PC for just $1,889.99 with free shipping after a $410 off instant discount. Acer Nitro 65 Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC for $1,890

Acer Nitro AMD Ryzen 9 9900X Radeon RX 9070 XT Gaming PC (32GB/1TB)

The Acer Nitro gaming PC is equipped with an AMD Ryzen 9 9900X CPU, AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 1TB SSD. The AMD Ryzen 9 9900X is a 12-core, 24-thread Zen 5 CPU with a max turbo boost of 5.6GHz, making it a solid multi-purpose CPU for gaming, productivity, and even AI. 32GB of RAM is plenty of memory for any gamer and the 1TB SSD is adequate storage for a boot drive. The AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT was the only 2025-released GPU that we gave a 10/10 score . articles.title: GTA 6 Features a Few Cheeky Dexter Easter Eggs
articles.summary: GTA 6 fans have uncovered a handful of Dexter Easter eggs after years of speculating the TV serial killer would be referenced in the game.
articles.body:
GTA 6 fans have uncovered a handful of Dexter Easter eggs after years of speculating that the TV serial killer might be referenced in the game.

Rockstar is known for including Easter eggs and nods to films, television, and even other games in the GTA franchise, so naturally, fans expected that Dexter might be referenced in GTA 6. The original TV series took place in Miami from 2006 to 2013, though subsequent revivals and sequel shows moved the series to New York. Many hoped that Rockstar would give a nod to the famous serial killer, who's best known for taking out bad guys — and it appears that they have.

Dexter's apartment can be found in Vice City, specifically near the top of Washington Island. The residence is inside a complex named "Trinity Apartments," seemingly in reference to one of Dexter's most famous villains, the Trinity Killer. If you go to his actual apartment, you will find an AC unit exactly where you'd expect it to be based on its positioning in the show. The AC unit in the series is used as a hiding place for Dexter's trophies, a box of glass slides with the blood of various people he has killed. If you head to the roof, you will also find a knife, rope, and even a syringe, which Dexter uses to sedate people.

Dexter Easter Eggs in Grand Theft Auto 6 🔥 💥 Dexter's Apartment at 'Trinity Apartments' 💥 'Slice of Life' Boat 💥 Tools on Roof including Syringe Located on Washington Island (Vice Beach) — DETONATED (@DETONATEDcom) November 19, 2026

Dexter Easter Eggs in Grand Theft Auto 6 🔥 💥 Dexter's Apartment at 'Trinity Apartments' 💥 'Slice of Life' Boat 💥 Tools on Roof including Syringe Located on Washington Island (Vice Beach)

And finally, you can also find a boat docked near the complex that looks very similar to Dexter's own aquatic vehicle, the Slice of Life. It's unclear if there are any other Dexter Easter eggs in the game, but if you want to find all of these for yourselves, watch the end of the video embedded above. It's possible that there is even a mass grave of body bags under the ocean or a serial killer running around for players to find, but these are things that might take a lot longer to discover.

Either way, it's a fun nod to a beloved show. We included the TV series on a list of films and shows fans should acquaint themselves with prior to GTA 6's release , expecting that there may be some Easter eggs for them. Other players have found references to Miami-based films such as Scarface, as well, so there are plenty of pop culture references to keep an eye out for while playing the game.

articles.title: Amazon Is Discounting a Cloud Buster Sword Replica for Black Friday This Year
articles.body:
Nintendo recently dropped a major discount on Final Fantasy VII Remake and Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, so naturally I caved and bought both ( they were under $8 !). That deal has come and gone, but after dumping too many hours into this game, I now understand the hype.

For long-time fans of the series, a discount on the best Final Fantasy games may not be all that enticing. But with Amazon's Black Friday sale happening now, there's a number of FF7-themed gifts available at a discount. One such deal is this incredible Cloud Strife replica sword. It's made out of stainless steel and is currently discounted to its lowest price since Prime Day .

As someone who actually owns multiple swords, I'll be the first to tell you nobody actually needs a giant sword. It's an impractical thing to add to your life and they are rather expensive. That being said, swords are awesome and Final Fantasy 7 is one of the most popular games in the world for a reason. So if you really want to add a thick buster sword to your life, you absolutely should.

Cloud Strife has become one of the most recognizable faces in gaming, getting added to the likes of Kingdom Hearts, Super Smash Bros., and even Magic the Gathering over the years. His signature buster sword is nearly as iconic as he is at this point.

The sword itself is made of stainless steel and is about 4.5 feet long when you include the handle. It isn't sharp, but it should be durable enough that you can probably smash an old Halloween pumpkin or two without worrying about it falling apart. It weighs almost 15 pounds, so it's definitely possible to wield if you're cosplaying as Cloud if you've got the arm strength for it.

This isn't the lowest price we've ever seen on this sword, but it's still a pretty good deal overall. With U.S. tariffs being placed on steel and many overseas manufacturers, there's no guarantee that prices will be dropping on these types of products any time soon. So if this is something you want to buy right now, this discount is definitely worth considering this year rather than in 2027.

With that in mind, there are still more Black Friday sales arriving next week and it's possible this particular sword could get a deeper discount. It dropped all the way down to $150 during Black Friday last year and could potentially see a similar discount again in 2026. The fact that it's sold on Amazon specifically, however, makes it unlikely that it will drop any further

articles.title: The Asus ROG Xbox Ally Has Dropped £120 in Price for Black Friday — Ready To Stream GTA 6
articles.summary: Amazon's Black Friday sale cuts the ASUS ROG Xbox Ally to £379.99, its lowest price since August, with Xbox Remote Play support for GTA 6.
articles.body:
Amazon UK has kicked off its Black Friday sales with a hefty £120 discount on the ASUS ROG Xbox Ally, making Microsoft's Xbox-branded handheld massively cheaper to pick up just as GTA 6 finally lands on consoles.

Right now, you can buy the standard white ASUS ROG Xbox Ally at Amazon UK for just £379.99 , down from its usual £499.99 RRP. Both a 24% saving and sold directly by Amazon rather than a third-party seller, IGN UK has confirmed that this is also the lowest price the handheld console’s seen since August.

Save On The ASUS ROG Xbox Ally And Stream GTA 6 For Less

ASUS ROG Xbox Ally Handheld Gaming Console

Whilst you can also grab an Amazon Resale used-like-new model for £360.99, this huge price drop means you’ll now just be spending an extra £19 on a brand-new unit.

The ROG Xbox Ally itself comes equipped with an AMD Ryzen Z2 A processor, 16GB RAM, and 512GB SSD, alongside a 7-inch Full HD touchscreen with a 120Hz refresh rate. There's also a 60Wh battery and Windows 11, meaning you're not restricted to Xbox games, with access to supported PC storefronts like Steam as well.

What's more, Amazon's offering here also includes three months of Xbox Game Pass Premium , letting you build up your library with hundreds of compatible games without spending anything extra on the subscription straight away.

Can You Play GTA 6 on the Rog Xbox Ally?

With Grand Theft Auto VI now available on Xbox Series X|S, there's one extra appealing reason to consider this deal: You can stream Rockstar's latest GTA sequel directly to the handheld through Xbox Remote Play.

Mind you, GTA 6 can't be played natively on the ROG Xbox Ally, since there's currently no PC version. Instead, you'll need an Xbox Series X|S with the game installed to stream it from your console.

To get started, simply enable Remote Features in your Xbox console's settings, then sign into the Xbox app on the handheld using the same Microsoft account. From there, you can connect to your console remotely and launch GTA 6, without having to sit in front of your TV.

For the smoothest gameplay, it's worth connecting your Xbox to your router via Ethernet and using a strong Wi-Fi connection on the Ally to keep latency down.

For even more Ocarina of Time apparel, Amazon also has dozens of Zelda-themed graphic t-shirts on sale for Black Friday. Many of them are Ocarina of Time themed, although focused on the original N64 release. There isn't any official remake merch quite yet, but you can bet we'll cover those if they're ever announced.

articles.title: Samsung Nintendo Switch 2 Memory Cards Are on Sale for Black Friday
articles.summary: Tested and vetted at IGN.
articles.body:
Sveral Black Friday deals on Nintendo Switch 2 accessories and video games are already under way. One of the most welcome deals is on Switch 2 memory. Ahead of November 27, Amazon has dropped the price of the highly rated Samsung P9 256GB Micro SDXC Express Card to $44.99 with free shipping. This is a slight $3 price drop from earlier this month and the lowest price I've seen in a while. The 512GB model is also on sale for $99.99. Are these the lowest prices ever ? No. Are there cheaper memory cards out there? Yes . But if you're looking for a memory card that we've personally tested and recommend , you won't find a better deal right now.

Samsung Nintendo Switch Memory Cards on Sale for Black Friday

The Switch 2 only comes with 256GB of onboard storage and it will run out faster than you think. If you have a standard MicroSD card from your previous Switch, it won't work on the Switch 2. Although the two might look similar, the MicroSD Express card is much faster than its predecessor. The Samsung P9 model boasts transfer speeds of up to 800MB/s.

Quite a few games have now been released for the Switch 2 and some of them require an enormous amount of space. Final Fantasy 14 is the most gigabyte-hungry game to date, requiring about 117GB all by itself. That game alone takes up half of the Switch 2's internal storage capacity. Other plus-sized games include Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade (90GB), Split Fiction (70GB), Cyberpunk 2077 (60GB), and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment (44GB). The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time tops out at about 27GB. Nowadays it's completely possible to download just three or four games and find yourself completely out of onboard storage.

articles.title: The PlayStation 5 Pro Console Is Going In and Out of Stock at Amazon
articles.summary: You'll need a combination of perseverance and luck to score one.
articles.body:
The PlayStation 5 Pro will certainly not be discounted on Black Friday. In fact, you'd be lucky just to find one for retail price. Fortunately, Amazon appears to be restocking PlayStation 5 Pro consoles on a very sporadic basis. You can't just buy the console alone, you'll need to select a bundle. The least expensive bundle is the PS5 Pro with charging station for $928.99 with free shipping. Don't be surprised if you click on the link and the console is out of stock again. Keep checking back and your perserverance (and luck) might eventually pay off.

PlayStation 5 Pro Going In and Out of Stock at Amazon

Sony PlayStation 5 Pro Console With Charging Station

The PlayStation 5 Pro console was released on November of 2024. This is a more powerful version of the standard PS5 console. Normally you would have to choose between "Quality mode" with true 4K graphics and a lower 30fps max framerate or a "Performance mode" with upscaled 1440p (or lower) graphics with up to 60fps max framerate. However, thanks to the power of the new PS5 Pro console, you can get native 4K resolution and up to 60fps max framerate in many if not most games. It doesn't include a disc drive as standard. You'd need to buy an add-on disc drive unit for $79.

After thirteen years of waiting, GTA 6 is finally out. IGN's Luke Reilly gave it a well-deserved 10/10 "Masterpiece" rating . I'm pretty convinced that no other game will be played on PlayStation or Xbox consoles in the days following. According to Jackie's GTA 6 performance analysis , the PS5 Pro is currently the best way to play the game. Just note that you're still locked at 30fps, but you'll benefit from the additional horsepower along with ray tracing and VRR tech.

articles.title: 'GTA 6' release live updates: Reviews, memes and more as gamers explore and react to Vice City after 13 long years
articles.summary: After a long wait, the sequel to 'GTA 5' is out and people are stoked.
articles.body: Grand Theft Auto VI is here at last and gamers around the world can finally play after it launched at midnight globally. So far the game, which takes up a whopping 212GB on your PlayStation5 or Xbox, is receiving rave reviews. GTA 6 is streaming all over Twitch and the memes, clips and hot takes are pouring in.Digital marketing firm Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 pre-orders have already topped $1.65 billion in sales. GTA 6 costs $79.99 for PS5 and Xbox, with an "ultimate" version priced at $99.99. Players began pre-loading GTA 6 last week, even though they probably had to clear some space on their consoles. Millions of people are expected to take time off work and school to play GTA 6. Xbox has a doctor's note from DJ Khaled (aka Dr. Xbox) that may be the excuse you need (but you'll probably want to clear it with your boss either way).PlayStation's network suffered a brief outage Wednesday afternoon as the game became available and players made the required update to their consoles. But since Wednesday evening, it's been smooth sailing. Here's what people are saying about GTA VI today:
